payload.text: Closes smell S6 (the dark gate) and gap G4 (nothing distinguishes a gate that is armed from one that is dark). IMPLEMENT: give doctor a check-liveness table -- (check name, coverage probe, expected floor) -- and FAIL when a shipped gate's policy file is ABSENT or its scope resolves to zero tracked files. Keep ADR-037's asymmetry: an EMPTY policy file is a conscious statement and passes; an ABSENT one is dark and fails. Then apply the same rule inside fact-health, spec-health and doc-health: a sweep that examined nothing reports FAIL, not ok. The release battery already does this for its six arms and is the reference implementation. VALIDATE: (1) canary arms in a fixture repo -- absent citation-scope FAILS doctor, empty PASSES, a scope matching zero tracked files FAILS; (2) historical simulation -- check out the v0.9.22 commit that shipped ADR-036 and confirm the rule would have failed doctor that day, which is the whole claim; (3) confirm no currently-green check goes red for a reason that is not a true finding (spec-health resolving zero files here IS a true finding and must be resolved consciously, not suppressed). DONE WHEN: ADR-042 is Accepted, doctor fails a fixture with an absent policy file, and the canary carries the three arms.

payload.text: Closes smell S2 (enumeration that never terminates) and the three demonstrated write channels. Highest-leverage security item open; also the prerequisite for any future design that widens automatic execution. IMPLEMENT: execute the screen's own token stream as argv instead of handing the string to /bin/sh; the runner owns the two allowed redirections and expands globs with stdlib glob; anything with no argv equivalent is refused rather than approximated. Land ADR-040's R1-R3 in the same pass (denied long options matched as prefixes so getopt abbreviations cannot slip; glued and clustered short options; per-program output positionals with a bare dash counted as a word). VALIDATE, in this order: (1) HASH STABILITY FIRST -- replay all 116 filed evidence commands under the new runner and require byte-identical output hashes, because a silent hash change diverges live claims; (2) canary arms asserting the three channels are impossible by construction, not merely filtered: uniq with a glob operand, a read-write open, a bare digit redirect target; (3) decide and document the unmatched-glob semantics (a shell leaves the pattern as a literal word, Python's glob returns nothing -- this changes argv AND exit codes); (4) a FRESH adversarial reviewer attacks the new runner before it lands, because the last patch in this area passed 235 canary arms and was then broken three ways. DONE WHEN: no evidence command reaches /bin/sh, the replay shows zero hash changes, and an independent red team fails to break it.

payload.text: Closes smell S4 at its source. Measured: half of all claims embed a version literal, so they MUST diverge every release; one claim was re-filed 13 generations, another 9; 44 of 49 retractions are supersession bookkeeping rather than judgements that something was false. IMPLEMENT: a new INTAKE_GATES row, decidable regex, refusing a sentence that pins a present-tense version or count its own evidence already proves at HEAD. Exclude identifier tokens (ADR-NNN, INV-x, FAULT tags, issue numbers) which collide with the count pattern. Provide --version-literal-ok with a stored basis, counted in stats beside the other overrides. The literal-free form already exists in this ledger and should be the message's suggested rewrite: compare the two surfaces in the evidence command rather than naming the version in the sentence. VALIDATE: ADR-035-style historical simulation against all 142 filed claims. The panel measured 25 refusals of which 2 were wrong (pilot pins, where the specific version IS the fact); reproduce that, then drive false refusals to zero via the identifier exclusion before shipping. Note the refusal rate is roughly nine times ADR-035's, so the override must be genuinely usable. DONE WHEN: the simulation shows zero false refusals and the gate ships with its override counted.

Also required: a ledger-compatibility statement for consumers running an older CLI against a ledger containing the new field, since the pilot has lagged twenty releases before. Replay against history: the queue should go to zero without hiding anything real. DONE WHEN: the confluence proof is in the canary and the replayed queue is empty of bookkeeping.

payload.text: Closes smell S9 (alarm fatigue) as a MECHANISM rather than as a habit. This repo has had three instances: the 108-failure tripwire ignored for weeks, a warning swallowed by a tail -1 pipe (QB-011), and a diverged queue that is currently 100 percent noise. Each was fixed by a human eventually noticing. IMPLEMENT: every advisory class carries an emission counter and an act-rate; a class whose measured act-rate collapses over a window is auto-demoted to silence AND files an issue saying so, rather than continuing to shout. Pair it with the entry requirement for refusals that ADR-035 already demonstrated: simulate against the historical corpus with near-zero false refusals before shipping any new refusal row. VALIDATE: replay against history and require that nothing currently acted upon is demoted; the demotion mechanism is itself a gate and must therefore ship as a report for one release first, by its own rule. payload.text: Closes smell S8. VALIDATE: run across all 228 existing arms; any arm that survives every mutation is either vacuous or pinning something the mutation did not touch, and both cases need a human look. Expect this to find real vacuous arms -- if it finds none, suspect the harness rather than celebrating. payload.text: Closes smell S1. The quantifier gate matched substrings during this session: the phrase read-only tripped it because it contains only, and an explanatory clause tripped it because it contained whole. Each time the fix was to reword rather than rethink -- which is compliance theatre, the exact ADR-011 lesson one layer up. IMPLEMENT: match quantifier tokens on word boundaries rather than substrings; audit every refusal message so it names the DEFECT rather than the token that fired, and so its suggested remedy cannot be satisfied by cosmetic rewording. VALIDATE: build a corpus from the real refusals of this session plus the historical ones; require that a semantically-identical rephrasing does NOT flip the verdict in either direction -- if rewording alone changes the outcome, the gate is testing spelling rather than meaning. Canary arms for the substring cases specifically. DONE WHEN: read-only and similar false positives no longer fire, and no message can be satisfied by a synonym.

payload.text: Closes gap G1. Verdicts are treated as sound by construction, yet this session produced a verifier fix that CREATED the next stale stamp, and four successive verifiers each found a different defect in one claim -- meaning the first three each declared a judgement while missing what the next one saw. IMPLEMENT: sample a small fraction of agree verdicts for re-judgement by a second independent verifier, and record the disagreement rate as a first-class number. VALIDATE: measure the baseline on history first -- re-dispatch a sample of past agrees and see how often a second verifier disagrees. That number decides whether this mechanism is worth keeping; if the disagreement rate is near zero it should be deleted rather than shipped, and saying so in advance is what makes this an experiment rather than a ritual. DONE WHEN: a baseline disagreement rate exists and the keep-or-delete decision is recorded.

VALIDATE: file a claim watching the artifact and confirm a simulated deployment bump stales it; confirm the existing absolute-path claim class is either migrated or refused; check the artifact cannot silently drift from reality by making the sync the only writer. DONE WHEN: a deployment version change stales a claim in this repo without anyone remembering to look.

That is the only honest test: the measure is whether the protocol catches the genus early, not whether it sounds wise. DONE WHEN: the verifier protocol asks the altitude question explicitly and the replay shows it firing at round one.

payload.text: SUPERSEDES wk-0691c742, which was scoped to sampling verdict quality. That scope misses the sharp edge: the problem is not that verdicts might be wrong, it is that the ledger holds NO EVIDENCE the verifier was ever a different session. MEASURED 2026-08-01 over 133 first-agree pairs: zero same-session agrees exist, so ADR-010's author-not-verifier gate has never fired; median author-to-first-agree is 3.3 minutes; 33 are under sixty seconds; the fastest is 0.282 seconds, author session operator-gates-implementation, verifier session verifier-v0922-sweep. No fresh session read and judged a claim that had existed for a third of a second. session() returns whatever TRUTH_SESSION says, so the gate compares two strings the same process can choose. The system's most load-bearing property -- that live means independently verified -- is currently an attestation, inside a ledger built on the premise that unevidenced assertions rot. WHAT WILL NOT WORK, and why, so nobody rebuilds it: cryptographic signing is void here because one operator on one machine holds every key, and this repo already red-teamed and falsified a linear hash chain for this regime; a refusal keyed on latency is worse than nothing because it is defeated by a sleep and it TEACHES that bypass, which is the confused-deputy shape ADR-011 exists to prevent. IMPLEMENT, in the honest order: (1) surface what the existing records already prove, with NO schema change -- author-to-first-verdict latency and whether a session both authored claims and filed verdicts on those same claims are both derivable from the ledger today, retroactively; (2) report them in truth stats and warn in doctor, ADVISORY only, never a refusal; (3) correct the documentation so live is described as what it is -- the paper's honest-limitations section is the right home, and the ADR-021 lesson applies: name the boundary you actually enforce rather than the one you wish you had. THEN the decision that is the operator's, not this item's: either separation becomes genuinely evidenced (harness-supplied session provenance the CLI cannot forge -- both Claude Code and pi know their own identity, but an agent can write any file inside the repo, so this needs a channel outside it), or it is DISCLOSED as a process property the machinery does not enforce. Both are defensible; pretending is not. VALIDATE: replay against history -- the surface must flag the 33 sub-sixty-second first-agrees and the 0.282s case, and must NOT flag this session's genuinely independent verifications, where fresh agents each ran dispatch, read files, and took minutes. Derive any threshold from the measured distribution rather than guessing it: a guessed threshold in ADR-039 would have refused 82 of 96 real filings, and that replay is why the gate did not ship. Report the false-positive rate before choosing. DONE WHEN: the ledger can show, from its own records, which verifications carry evidence of separation and which carry only a name -- and the docs no longer claim more than that.

That was a GOOD decision then -- preserving the old corpus was the equivalence proof -- but the migration is over, the proof is delivered, and gc.get_referrers in the production loading path is the kind of thing that breaks on a Python upgrade and produces a failure nobody can read. Scope: replace the monkeypatch seam with an explicit one (a configure() entry, or injection of the patched paths), then delete _MirrorModule and _self_module. Znalezisko wspolne 2026-08-22: wykrycie sesja 013jva2WUTrMH9MrjV1N1wxB (zla liczba ramion), przesledzenie historii sesja 01HzSxqVKRdYhu8aSCK6B2bX (slepota kapsuly). Koryguje tez mianownik w wk-5cbbc965.

KAPSULA tr-38d32bc7 to doslownie:
  grep -oE '^# --- [0-9]+[.] [a-z]+' scripts/release-battery.sh
a zdanie claimu mowilo 'TEN numbered arms'.

PRZEBIEG (odtwarzalny, kolumna 'kapsula' to powyzszy grep, 'faktycznie' to grep -cE '^# --- [0-9]'):
  c0ff7f3  08-17 13:55   10 / 10   <- kotwica claimu, DOKLADNA
  2822d8e  08-17 19:50   10 / 11   <- konwencja 'Nb' wchodzi (5b), slepota po ~6 h
  d5d0259  08-18 14:42   10 / 12   <- 8b (label-coupling)
  4760366  08-20 21:36   10 / 12
  328760c  08-21 22:26   11 / 13
Komenda odtwarzajaca: for c in c0ff7f3 2822d8e d5d0259 4760366 328760c; do git show "${c}:scripts/release-battery.sh" | grep -cE '^# --- [0-9]+[.] [a-z]+'; done

Claim REPRODUKOWAL SIE NA ZIELONO PRZEZ CZTERY DNI, bedac falszywym. Wzorzec [0-9]+[.] wymaga kropki zaraz po cyfrze, wiec nie widzi 5b ani 8b. Pekl dopiero przypadkiem -- bo nowa sekcja nazywa sie '11.' z kropka. Gdyby nazwac ja '10b.', claim bylby dzis zielony i falszywy.

KLASA: kapsula grepujaca WZOR jest warta tyle, ile pokrycie tego wzoru dla form, ktore dopiero powstana. Zielone znaczylo tu nie 'fakt nadal zachodzi', tylko 'moj regex nadal lapie ten sam podzbior'. ADR-051 stoi na tezie, ze to jedno i to samo -- ten przypadek pokazuje, ze nie zawsze.

Gorzej: ten grep zawodzi FAIL-OPEN, czyli pokazuje MNIEJ bramek niz jest. Kontrast: gate-reachability.sh jest fail-safe z projektu ('a variable-built path reads as unreachable, never as reached'). Licznik zaniżający wyglada rozsadnie i nikt go nie kwestionuje.

DO ROZWAZENIA (nie rozstrzygam):
 1. czy da sie odroznic kapsule ENUMERUJACA (grep wzorca -- podatna) od KARDYNALNEJ (wc -l pliku, ls katalogu -- odporna), i czy intake powinien to sygnalizowac;
 2. jesli rejestr ADR-047 mialby liczyc ramiona baterii (wariant (a) z wk-5cbbc965), potrzebuje ZRODLA LICZBY odpornego na nastepna konwencje nazewnicza. 'wc -l .truth/label-coupling-opt-out' jest odporne; 'grep -c' po naglowkach sekcji nie jest.

KOREKTA DO wk-5cbbc965: jego tytul i tresc mowia '1 z 12 ramion'. Prawidlowo 1 z 13 (grep -cE '^# --- [0-9]' scripts/release-battery.sh). Pod wariantem (a) brakujacych wierszy jest DWANASCIE, nie jedenascie. Sam fakt i obie odpowiedzi (a)/(b) stoja bez zmian -- zmienia sie mianownik. Wpisalem tam liczbe do zdania, ktorego nic nie pilnuje, czyli popelnilem dokladnie ten blad, ktory ten ticket opisuje.

evidence.command: grep -oE '^# --- [0-9]+b?[.] [a-z]+' scripts/release-battery.sh

payload.text: the release battery at scripts/release-battery.sh names its arms in numbered section headers, and the set it carries at the push boundary is exactly the one this capsule enumerates -- schema, cross-surface version lockstep, citation tripwire, doc hygiene, core and v04 suites, structural selectors, scoped canary, integration suite, field-consumers audit, label-coupling audit, reachability sweep, reproduction sweep, and the battery meta-gate that runs its own regression harness (successor to tr-38d32bc7, whose sentence carried a count literal and whose capsule was blind to the Nb naming form introduced after it was filed)

evidence.command: grep -E '^# --- [0-9]' scripts/release-battery.sh | grep -vE '^# --- [0-9]+b?[.] [a-z]'

payload.scope_basis: the quantifier ranges over exactly the domain the command enumerates: the first grep IS the domain ('# --- <digit>' headers in this one file) and the second subtracts the conforming subset, so an empty output is an exhaustive check over that domain rather than a sample of it -- and the sentence already names what falls outside
payload.text: in scripts/release-battery.sh, each section header that begins '# --- <digit>' also conforms to one of the two forms the arm-enumerating capsules match, N. and Nb.: this capsule emits that domain minus the conforming subset and its output is empty, so a third naming form breaks it loudly instead of silently shrinking what the sibling claim enumerates. The domain is the header prefix itself, so a header written without it stays outside this guard -- the fail-closed pairing the tr-38d32bc7 blindness showed was missing, not a total one

payload.basis: self-diverged minutes after filing, on the intake advisory this session should have heeded before pressing enter. The capsule 'grep -E ... | grep -vE ...' exits 1 in its CONFORMING state, because grep -v with no selected lines exits 1 -- so the green reading is indistinguishable from an unreadable file, a renamed path, or a first grep that matched nothing. A stably-failing probe verifies nothing (ADR-035 family). Successor uses the positive form '... | wc -l', which emits 0 and exits 0 when the domain conforms and 1 when it does not, keeping the fail-closed property while making the healthy state legible.

evidence.command: grep -E '^# --- [0-9]' scripts/release-battery.sh | grep -vE '^# --- [0-9]+b?[.] [a-z]' | wc -l

payload.scope_basis: the quantifier ranges over exactly the domain the command enumerates: the first grep IS the domain ('# --- <digit>' headers in this one file) and the rest subtracts the conforming subset and counts what is left, so a zero is an exhaustive check over that domain rather than a sample -- and the sentence names what falls outside
payload.text: in scripts/release-battery.sh, each section header that begins '# --- <digit>' also conforms to one of the two forms the arm-enumerating capsules match, N. and Nb.: this capsule counts that domain minus the conforming subset and the count is zero, so a third naming form raises it and breaks the capsule loudly instead of silently shrinking what the sibling claim enumerates. It asserts positively -- emitting 0 and exiting 0 when healthy -- because the complement-emitting form it replaces exited 1 in its own conforming state. The domain is the header prefix itself, so a header written without it stays outside this guard (successor to tr-858be922)

payload.text:
Znalezione przy niezaleznym przegladzie commita 4cbda7a (sesja 013jva2WUTrMH9MrjV1N1wxB, 2026-08-22). Zgloszone przez sesje 01HzSxqVKRdYhu8aSCK6B2bX jako 'nie moje do rozstrzygniecia'; zmierzone i zafilowane tutaj, zeby nie umarlo z sesja.

.truth/citation-scope mowi o sobie w naglowku: 'SCOPE = the live prose corpus, kept in LOCKSTEP with scripts/fact-health.sh. Both answer one question -- which prose is a reader meant to act on today? -- so they must not drift apart.'

ROZJECHALY SIE. citation-scope wylicza POZYTYWNIE (README, AGENTS, 8 nazwanych plikow, docs/diagrams/*.md, docs/growth-gate/*.md), a fact-health.sh:99 sweepuje 'docs/*.md docs/**/*.md' MINUS szesc wykluczen. Zbiory nie sa rowne.

POMIAR (dzis, 2026-08-22): fact-health sweepuje 30 plikow; 9 z nich jest POZA citation-scope, wiec bramka retrakcji ADR-036 ich nie widzi:

  docs/agent-onboarding.md
  docs/decisions/054-doctor-resolves-delegated-gate.md
  docs/decisions/055-churn-floor-refusal-and-structural-exemption.md
  docs/decisions/056-shell-free-evidence-execution-implemented.md
  docs/decisions/README.md
  docs/governance/gate-metrics.md
  docs/governance/operator-actions-2026-08-22.md
  docs/governance/operator-actions-2026-08.md
  docs/specs/structural-selectors.md

Odtwarzalne: policzyc git ls-files wg linii 99-105 fact-health.sh i sprawdzic kazdy plik wobec globow z citation-scope semantyka match_paths ('*' nie przekracza '/', '**' przekracza).

SKUTEK OBSERWOWANY, nie hipotetyczny: 2026-08-22 'truth citations tr-599e7561' odpowiedzialo 'clean' (docs/governance/ poza scope), a fact-health na tym samym id dal FAIL. Bramka przepuscila retrakcje, na ktorej sweep pada. To jest odwrotnosc tego, przed czym ostrzega naglowek tego samego pliku: 'An armed-looking gate that checks nothing is worse than no gate: it manufactures confidence.'

DO ROZSTRZYGNIECIA (operatorskie, nie agenta):
 (a) citation-scope dogania fact-health -- dopisac 9 plikow albo przejsc na wyliczanie pozytywne katalogow (docs/decisions/*.md, docs/governance/*.md, docs/specs/*.md, docs/agent-onboarding.md);
 (b) fact-health zawezic do citation-scope -- ale wtedy przestanie pilnowac cytowan w plikach, ktore SA instrukcjami dla czytelnika;
 (c) uznac, ze to sa dwa rozne pytania i USUNAC zdanie o LOCKSTEP z naglowka citation-scope, bo dzis jest falszywe.

Wariant (c) jest najtanszy i najuczciwszy, jesli rozjazd jest zamierzony. Czego NIE nalezy robic: zostawic zdania o lockstep bez zmiany, bo to jest twierdzenie o wlasnej spojnosci, ktorego nic nie pilnuje -- ta sama klasa co wk-96a3bd63.
